test_title: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 01 Sept, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: As announced in January 2025, which Indian pharmaceutical company is set to manufacture Paracetamol domestically?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Satya Deeptha Pharmaceuticals**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Satya Deeptha Pharmaceuticals** is an Indian pharmaceutical company known for producing high-quality generic medicines.
 
• In **January 2025**, the company announced its decision to manufacture **Paracetamol** domestically in India. Paracetamol is a widely used over-the-counter medication for pain relief and fever reduction.
 
• The decision to manufacture Paracetamol domestically aligns with the Indian government’s initiative to promote **local production of pharmaceuticals** under the **‘Atmanirbhar Bharat’ (Self-reliant India)** campaign.
 
• Manufacturing Paracetamol within the country reduces dependency on imports, especially from countries like **China**, which has been a major supplier of bulk drugs and active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs).
 
• This initiative is expected to contribute significantly to the **Make in India** movement and enhance India's pharmaceutical capacity.
 
• Satya Deeptha Pharmaceuticals has a reputation for its focus on quality, affordability, and innovation in drug production.
 
• Paracetamol is one of the most common drugs globally, used in a variety of formulations, making its domestic production a strategic move for India’s healthcare industry.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Ajanta Pharmaceuticals**__

 __
 
• **Ajanta Pharmaceuticals** is an Indian multinational company that manufactures and markets pharmaceutical products globally.
 
• The company specializes in **therapeutic segments** such as ophthalmology, dermatology, and cardiology.
 
• While Ajanta Pharmaceuticals is a leading name in the pharmaceutical sector, it has not been associated with domestic manufacturing of **Paracetamol** as of January 2025.
 
 
 
• **Alkem Laboratories**__
 __
 
• **Alkem Laboratories**, founded in 1973, is a prominent Indian company involved in the development, manufacturing, and sale of pharmaceutical and nutraceutical products.
 
• Although it has a strong presence in the pharmaceutical sector, the company is not linked to Paracetamol production initiatives in the given context.
 
 
 
• **Lupin**__
 
 
• **Lupin** is one of the top pharmaceutical companies in India, focusing on branded and generic formulations, biotechnology products, and APIs.
 
• The company is known for its work in areas such as cardiology, diabetology, asthma, and anti-infectives. However, it was not mentioned in the context of producing Paracetamol domestically.
